versions.changelog: v1.2.0: Added getattr() dynamic dispatch detection, .vetterrc weaponization protection, entropy noise reduction (90% fewer false positives on lock files), IOC threat intelligence matching, prompt injection detection, environment security checks. Ground truth expanded to 73 real ClawHub skills.

v1.1.0: Integrated IOC threat intelligence matching (C2 IPs, malicious domains, malicious publishers, file hashes, attack name patterns), added prompt injection detection (INJECT-001/002), AMOS stealer marker detection (MALWARE-001), and new --env-check mode for OpenClaw environment security auditing (credential permissions, memory poisoning, API key leakage, persistence detection, PATH hijacking).

Initial release: programmatic security scanner with 65+ detection rules, Python AST analysis, Shannon entropy detection, URL/IP extraction, permission scope inference, and Markdown context awareness to reduce false positives.
